note: Components below are reusable by other WASHINGTON jobs as code (deterministic generators) or as material slots. Building identities themselves are named overrides and are not for generic PCG repetition.

generator_components.name: facade frame + wall_with_openings
generator_components.what: facade-local frame (a along facade, b outward, c height) and a solid slab with rectangular through-openings decomposed into maximal closed boxes, so every reveal is real geometry; works on any edge direction (diagonal avenues)

generator_components.name: corner rule + obtuse-corner wedge fill (cannon_slab_edges)
generator_components.what: facade slabs around any CCW footprint: right-angle corners by the stop-short rule, obtuse corners by a hidden wedge prism; no coplanar z-fighting faces
candidate_users: any non-orthogonal L'Enfant block (New Jersey / Pennsylvania / Delaware avenues)

generator_components.name: window_unit
generator_components.what: frame + glazing + mullions/transoms set into a reveal; LOD-aware; glass slot A/B for night-lit selection

generator_components.name: fluted_pilaster / doric_profile + fluted lathe
generator_components.what: flat fluted pilasters with real channels at LOD0; Vignola-proportioned Roman Doric column profile with entasis, 20 flutes (2 segments per flute) - a background-LOD Doric (~1.8k tris per column)
generator_components.unification: proposed as the runtime-light Doric variant missing from DC-C19 v004 (see HANDOFF UNIFICATION PROPOSALS)

generator_components.name: balustrade / sweep mouldings
generator_components.what: mitred profile sweeps along closed or open footprints (plinths, band courses, cornices, coping, balustrade rails) + LOD-aware balusters

generator_components.name: relief_standin_smooth / relief_blob / anthemion
generator_components.what: labelled simplified stand-ins for rights-unconfirmed figural relief (smooth domed forms, never likenesses) and the Annex honeysuckle (anthemion) ornament
generator_components.rights_rule: use only where faithful reproduction is not cleared (stage standard section 7)

generator_components.name: text_inscription
generator_components.what: carved inscription stand-in from verified wording (thin darker-marble letter solids, degenerate faces stripped)

generator_components.name: ring_prism / offset_polygon_per_edge
generator_components.what: closed prisms of courtyard buildings (outer polygon with one hole) and per-edge polygon insets (loggias, attics)

material_slots.use: 1930s Georgia white marble ashlar, 0.61 m courses
day glazing A / night-lit candidate B
